num_customers: <int> Number of original customers to be served.
vehicle_capacity: <int> Maximum combined delivery and pickup load a single vehicle can carry at any time.

customers.x: <int> Horizontal coordinate of the customer location.
customers.y: <int> Vertical coordinate of the customer location.
customers.delivery_demand: <int> Quantity of goods to be delivered from the depot to this customer.
customers.pickup_demand: <int> Quantity of goods to be picked up from this customer and returned to the depot.

distance_matrix: <list[list[int]], shape [num_customers+1][num_customers+1]> Rounded Euclidean distance between each pair of locations, where row/column 0 is the depot and rows/columns 1 through num_customers are the customers.
